findings.summary: On unseen layouts from the training map families, Gannet achieves higher success rates than Ledger-RNN across all three families (Warehouse: 88.4% vs 81.2%; Office: 85.1% vs 79.6%; Cavern: 79.3% vs 72.5%).
findings.scope: Unseen layouts from Warehouse, Office, Cavern; success rate metric; mean over 5 seeds.
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; differences are descriptive only.

findings.summary: Gannet also produces shorter mean episode lengths on successful episodes than Ledger-RNN across all three families (Warehouse: 142 vs 158 steps; Office: 151 vs 163; Cavern: 177 vs 189).
findings.scope: Unseen layouts from Warehouse, Office, Cavern; mean episode length of successful episodes; mean over 5 seeds.
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; differences are descriptive only.

findings.summary: The evidence does not address generalization beyond the trained map families, because all evaluations are on unseen layouts from the same three families used in training.
findings.scope: Evaluation scope is limited to training map families; no held-out map families were tested.
findings.caveats: The research question asks about generalization beyond trained families, but the supplied data only covers unseen layouts within those families.

sentences.text: On unseen layouts from the three map families used in training, Gannet achieved higher success rates than Ledger-RNN across all families (Warehouse: 88.4% vs 81.2%; Office: 85.1% vs 79.6%; Cavern: 79.3% vs 72.5%).
Gannet also produced shorter mean episode lengths on successful episodes than Ledger-RNN in every family (Warehouse: 142 vs 158 steps; Office: 151 vs 163; Cavern: 177 vs 189).

However, these results are descriptive only, as no statistical tests were reported, and they do not address generalization beyond the trained map families because all evaluations used unseen layouts from the same three families.
